title: Telegram Desktop data
whyItMatters: Telegram keeps cached messages and downloaded media locally. It shows which account was signed in and how much chat data is on disk.
source: Telegram Desktop standalone data path ~/Library/Application Support/Telegram Desktop/tdata - https://kb.macfor.io/docs/communication/telegram
notes: Mac App Store build uses ~/Library/Containers/ru.keepcoder.Telegram/Data/Library/Application Support/Telegram Desktop instead. tdata is never opened.

cleanup.exportFirst: Save the media and files you still need from Telegram, because the local cache goes with the folder.
cleanup.signOut: In Telegram, open Settings, then the menu in the top right corner, and choose Log out, so this Mac stops using the account.
steps: Quit Telegram so its data folder is not in use.
Move Telegram to the Trash from Applications and empty the Trash.
Delete the Telegram Desktop folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: The local message cache and downloaded media are removed from this Mac. Chats stay in the Telegram account.
cleanup.source: Telegram, How do I log out? (Telegram FAQ): https://telegram.org/faq#q-how-do-i-log-out
